openwrt_wiki.Warnung oben: The C50v4 is leaking LAN traffic through WAN port during boot, due to lack of port isolation.
openwrt_wiki.Einleitung: Dual band router with 5 fast (100mbps) ethernet ports. Advertised as AC1200 for its 867Mbps (2x2) 5GHz band and 300 Mbps (2x2) 2.4GHz band. The v1 and v5 have two non-detachable antennas. The v3 and v4 have four non-detachable antennas.
openwrt_wiki.Flash Layout (allgemein, nicht v4-spezif: mtd0 UBoot 128KiB | mtd1 firmware 7808KiB (kernel, rootfs, rootfs_data) | mtd5 config 64KiB | mtd6 rom 64KiB | mtd7 romfile 64KiB | mtd8 radio 64KiB
openwrt_wiki.v4 installation instructions: Warnung: Do NOT flash the tplink_C50-v4-squashfs-sysupgrade.bin from the "Downloads" section to the C50 v4 via the TPlink firmware's web GUI. It will brick the router!
openwrt_wiki.v4 installation instructions: Regionen: The OEM .bin firmware file for EU version 'Archer C50(EU)_V4_190125' has same checksum as the Brazil version 'Archer C50(BR)_V4_190125'. The Canadian version uses EU firmware .bin file as well. It is believed the C50 v4 hardware (except for AC power adapter) is the same for all regions.
openwrt_wiki.v4 installation instructions: Rückweg: To create a sysupgrade image to revert from OpenWrt to stock TPlink firmware follow https://forum.openwrt.org/t/support-for-archer-c50-v4/20174/88
openwrt_wiki.v4 installation instructions: pre-built: pre-built 19.07 snapshot images by forum user bill888 (https://forum.openwrt.org/t/support-for-archer-c50-v4/20174/107); WARNING: NOT for use with v5
openwrt_wiki.v4 and v5 TFTP instructions: dd if=/dev/zero of=tp_recovery.bin bs=196608 count=1; dd if=tpl.bin of=tmp.bin bs=131584 count=1; dd if=tmp.bin of=boot.bin bs=512 skip=1; cat boot.bin >> tp_recovery.bin; cat owrt.bin >> tp_recovery.bin
openwrt_wiki.v4 and v5: Update Jan 2020: It has been reported the C50 v4 sysupgrade image also works with C50 v5 (US version). The C50 v5 appears to be only sold in the USA.
openwrt_wiki.v4 and v5: Update Jul 2020: The A5 v5 (US version) appears to be same hardware as the C50 v5. It even uses the same TPlink OEM firmware.
openwrt_wiki.TFTP-Werte v3 & v4: Bootloader tftp server IPv4 address 192.168.0.66 (on the PC); Firmware tftp image tp_recovery.bin; TFTP transfer window: About 10 seconds after power on, while holding the RESET button; TFTP window start: Must power on pressing the RESET button; TFTP client required IP address 192.168.0.x
openwrt_wiki.TFTP allgemein: After each flashing attempt, wait at least for 3 or more leds to turn on and\or 3 minutes. If you try again before that the device will brick
openwrt_wiki.TFTP Recovery: For the v3/v4 EU version the file name is: tp_recovery.bin; press and hold Reset Button during powering (8 sec.) on until all LEDs stops to blink and the WPS LED turns on; stripped stock firmware for bricked C50 v4: https://forum.openwrt.org/t/restoring-stock-firmware-for-archer-c50-v4/63773/9
openwrt_wiki.Network interfaces: br-lan LAN & WiFi 192.168.1.1/24; vlan1 (eth0.1) LAN ports (1 to 4); vlan2 (eth0.2) WAN port DHCP; wlan0 WiFi 5 GHz; wlan1 WiFi 2,4 GHz
openwrt_wiki.Switch Ports (for VLANs): Internet (WAN) 0; LAN 1 -> 3; LAN 2 -> 4; LAN 3 -> 1; LAN 4 -> 2 ("Port 1 on the unit is number 3"); 6 = CPU
openwrt_wiki.Opening the case: Top cover (bluish), Bottom cover (gray); Remove the two screws on the bottom cover; Use a thin object to release the top cover
openwrt_wiki.Serial: Solder a header as shown in the picture or wires with a connector directly. TTL @ 3.3V. Resistor R600 and R601 are missing. (Foto archerc50_serial.jpg, v1)
openwrt_wiki.Hardware mods: SPI flash (e.g. W25Q64BV), replace with larger chips (16/32 MByte) possible with external programmer and flash layout modifications
openwrt_wiki.Notes Aug 2020: The cause for poor 2.4 GHz range experienced with some C50 v4 and probably C50 v5 models has been found. Also reports of random reboots. Fixed 2.4 GHz poor wifi speed (Feb 2021) from 19.07.7, mt76 commit 4ba1709c399b2f78ee987c1f0aff2b5da623244b (mt7603: add additional EEPROM chip ID); Bug Report FS#2781

openwrt_git_support.Installing via Recovery: Begin upgrade with TP-Link image, after ~3 seconds (update status 0%) disconnect power; comes up in Recovery-Mode on 192.168.0.1, all LEDs but WPS off, no DHCP (static IP); upload boot.bin

openwrt_git_support.Dual U-Boot: first TP-Link MediaTek device with split-uboot: factory-uboot (recovery TFTP/HTTP) jumps into firmware-uboot, which unpacks and executes the kernel
openwrt_git_support.Web-Recovery: Flag in romfile partition set by stock firmware before writing; bootloader starts Web-recovery on 192.168.0.1 when flag set; recovery mode indicated by illuminated WPS LED

gluon_commit_mt7603.Titel: mt76: mt7603: add additional EEPROM chip ID (#2133)
gluon_commit_mt7603.Text: Some newer MT7628 based routers (notably the TP-Link Archer C50 v4) are shipped with a chip-id of 0x7600 in the on-flash EEPROM. Add this as a possible valid ID. This fixes unstable WiFi on some units of the TP-Link Archer C50 v4.
